title: anywaye event envelope
description: The envelope every anywaye event travels in. CloudEvents 1.0-shaped: the context attributes below are CloudEvents attribute names and `specversion` pins the dialect. `data` is opaque here on purpose — the envelope only says that a payload is present; its shape is the per-event schema at schemas/events/<service>/<entity>/<action>.schema.json, which core owns. Contract tests validate the envelope, then the payload against that schema.

specversion.description: Envelope dialect version. Increments only for a breaking envelope change; new attributes require a major bump.

id.description: Unique per emission. Consumers deduplicate on this (delivery is at-least-once). Never reused for a re-emission of the same logical event.

type.description: <service>.<entity>.<action> — always three segments, always prefixed with the publishing service. See docs/event-naming.md.

source.description: Publishing service, matching `name` in its anywaye.yml and the first segment of `type`. CloudEvents' full URI form is /anywaye/<service>.

subject.description: Required. Identifier of the entity the event is about, e.g. 7c1a4e29-8b3d-4f6a-9e05-2d8c1b7a4f63 — a bare uuid wherever the entity is the publisher's own row, which is every identity and courier event (D7, whose `usr_` half was false, corrected by D35), and a third party's own id where the entity is a third party's record. Platform-wide events that have no single entity use the literal `platform` — a required field with a reserved value, not an absent one.

time.description: RFC3339 timestamp of the state change, UTC. Not the transport time.

data.description: Payload. Opaque to this schema; its shape is schemas/events/<service>/<entity>/<action>.schema.json, keyed by `type`.

eventType.description: <service>.<entity>.<action>, exactly three segments, with no exceptions. The first segment is a anywaye service name (kebab-case, so it may contain dashes but no underscores) and must equal the envelope's `source`; the entity and action segments are lowercase snake_case. See docs/event-naming.md.
